summary: [¶] Petition under Section 79 of the Electricity Act, 2003 seeking execution/implementation of the Order dated 22.10.2021 passed by this Hon’ble Commission in Petition No. 174/MP/2020 and initiation of proceedings under Section 142 of the Electricity Act, 2003 against Maharashtra State Electricity Distribution Company Limited and Tamil Nadu Generation and Distribution Corporation Limited in relation thereto. [¶] -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------Order in Petition No. 158/MP/2022 [¶] The Petitioner, GMR Warora Energy Limited, has filed the present Petition with [para 2] 2. During the course of hearing, the learned counsel for the Petitioner sought permission to withdraw the present Petition with liberty to file fresh Petition, if required. [para 4] 4. In view of the submissions of the learned counsels of the Petitioner and the Respondent, MSEDCL. the Petitioner is permitted to withdraw this Petition. [para 5] 5. Accordingly, the Petition No. 158/MP/2022 is disposed of as withdrawn.
